meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: NPR Tiny Desk: hides ad slots and the Plus, Shop and Newsletter links, blurs or hides concert pictures, can hide captions and teasers
meta.notes:
**Checked 2026-11-13**, logged out, headless Chrome on https://www.npr.org/series/tiny-desk-concerts/ with an iPhone UA and a desktop UA. Both received the same server-rendered page with a OneTrust cookie banner, which the existing generic rule already covers. A concert (story) page could not be captured (network dropped), so the video page, transcript and related-stories rails were not inspected.

- **Ad slot**: `div.ad-config` 1 (an empty Google Ad Manager slot in the Music zone) (LIVE).
- **Nav promos**: `.navigation__plus`, `.navigation__shop`, `.navigation__newsletters` 1 each inside `#globalheader` (LIVE).
- **Pictures**: `.imagewrap` 23 and `.imagewrap img` (LIVE); each wraps the link to the concert, so hiding it leaves the title link.
- **Captions** `.credit-caption` 23; **teasers** `article.item p.teaser` 24 (LIVE).

Not verified: concert pages, the lead video player (never hidden), podcasts pages, NPR One. Class names are plain and readable; no hashed names are used.
